name: Mandelbrot
author: LukeGrahamLandry
description: Explore the Mandelbrot fractal: Up/Down to zoom in and out, drag with mouse or touch to move around, X to toggle the Julia set.

descriptions.en: Explore the Mandelbrot fractal: Up/Down to zoom in and out, drag with mouse or touch to move around, X to toggle the Julia set.
descriptions.it: Esplora il frattale di Mandelbrot: su/giù per lo zoom, trascina con mouse o tocco per spostarti, X per passare all'insieme di Julia.
